notes: Six web searches ran, none refused. The site-restricted search returned no pages from juliabrownley.house.gov; a direct search of her site for 'artificial intelligence' returned only two results (13 March 2025 'Holding the Trump Administration Accountable' page, and an April 2024 release on DNA research biosecurity guardrails, which is before the search window); the first 100,000 characters of the long 2025 page had no mention of AI, the rest was not read. A search summary said she (spelled 'Bownley') signed a letter led by Rep. Deborah Ross from women lawmakers opposing a moratorium on state AI laws in the NDAA, on protections for women and girls (https://ross.house.gov/_cache/files/4/7/47241f79-476e-4384-9644-a6d6d1c923f3/0B2655828FC164F250E5A6635481C7CCCB14B0E9EA3B3E4F6A397519FDFD7FF1.final-ndaa-ai-moratorium-women-and-children-letter.pdf). I could not extract the PDF text to confirm her signature, date or wording, so it is not recorded; if confirmed it would be a D-level co-signed letter (state preemption, harms to women and children) and could make the grade D instead of none. The many-signer House AI letters of August and September 2026 were not searched for, as instructed.
